annotations.title: Senior housing development and lease-up calculator

description: Runs the Absorption development calculator on your inputs: total cost (land, hard, soft, construction interest, HUD fees), stabilized NOI, yield on cost and value, HUD 232 new construction loan (lowest of 90% of cost, the loan-to-value limit and 1.45x coverage), month-by-month lease-up to breakeven and stabilization, operating deficit and working capital escrows, and the equity left to fund. Unset inputs use the calculator page's example values.

average_drawn_pct.description: Average share of the loan drawn during construction, % (for interest carry).

building_type.description: Assisted living or memory care, or skilled nursing (sets the HUD loan-to-value limit).

cap_rate_pct.description: Cap rate on stabilized NOI, % (your assumption).

fixed_cost_per_month.description: Fixed operating cost per month (staff, utilities, overhead carried from day one), dollars.

hard_cost_per_unit.description: Hard cost per unit, dollars (your contractor's number; no public benchmark exists).

monthly_revenue_per_unit.description: Monthly revenue per occupied unit, dollars.

nonprofit.description: Nonprofit borrower with an operating track record (higher loan-to-value limit).

soft_cost_pct.description: Soft costs as % of hard cost.

variable_cost_per_unit_month.description: Variable cost per occupied unit per month, dollars.

name: absorption_calc
title: Senior housing development and lease-up calculator
